description: ( SRE ) Eolien terrestre, mats d'éoliennes en Vendée is a dataset listed in Data.vendee.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. L'énergie éolienne est produite à partir de la force du vent, grâce à une éolienne, qui transforme l'énergie mécanique du vent en énergie électrique. L'éolienne ou aérogénérateur, est constituée d'un mât sur lequel est fixée une hélice que fait tourner le vent. Coverage: Vendée. The portal files it under Territoires, Environnement. Its keywords are Energie, éolien. The portal shows 247 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-vendee-fr-portal.
